title: A rollover artefact and a clock error in free forex minute data: how histdata.com bars manufacture a time-of-day edge
description: Code, derived results and documentation for a study of free one-minute forex bars from histdata.com. The bar stamped 16:59 New York has a large negative mean return in all ten currency pairs examined (2015-2026) because the bars are built from bid prices and the spread widens at the 17:00 rollover; and the file timestamps are not the fixed UTC-5 clock the vendor documents (New York wall time with daylight saving up to 2018, the European daylight-saving calendar from 2019). Includes a tested clock-conversion and rollover-mask module (fxclock), a ten-step check, and an independent cross-check against FXCM bid/ask candles.
